cases.narrative: On 4/14/1993, bystanders found her body below the Edgewater Creek Bridge. Documents state at sometime between 9:30 p.m. and 2 a.m., Dean entered Lee's home while she was alone and struggled with her before he ultimately used ether to subdue her. The documents allege Dean took Lee to an unknown location where he sexually assaulted her and strangled her to death. According to the documents, Dean tossed Lee's body over the side of the Edgewater Creek Bridge, where she was later found by a passerby the next day. She had no shoes on and her underwear was on backwards.
